notes: The text after the second «شعبة» is written once and belongs to both routes (rule 3): it is the shared tail
«أبيه» is Abu Bakra, the Companion whose report of the Prophet's words is the saying; «الأقرع بن حابس» is in the scene only
«- وأحسب جهينة -» and «محمد الذي شك» are remarks inside the saying and «وليس في حديث ابن أبي شيبة» is about versions: none is chain
